This protocol compares the placeholder-row design returned by `nis_design()`
with a survey design built from the full invented data, before domain
subsetting. Fixtures come from `nis_example()` and contain no licensed records.

## Cases

- Complete pooled years (2017–2019), with cohort and non-cohort discharges
  across hospitals and years.
- A 2015-like partial cohort: Q4 only in 2015, pooled with a complete 2016.
- Invalid design rows in the input; the reference removes the same rows failing
  positive, finite `YEAR`, `HOSP_NIS`, `NIS_STRATUM`, or `DISCWT` checks.
- Annualized weights, divided by the count of valid-design years, including
  the partial year as one year.
- Complete quarter coverage is silent; incomplete cohort quarter coverage
  warns when annualizing.

## Compared statistics

At absolute tolerance `1e-8`, compare survey means and standard errors,
weighted totals and standard errors, `svyratio()` estimates and variance,
`confint()` for means, `svyby()` estimates and standard errors, logistic and
Gaussian `svyglm()` coefficients and covariance matrices, and median
`svyquantile()` estimates. Compare design degrees of freedom exactly and the
gtsummary p-values at `1e-8`. Annualized totals are compared with full-data
reference totals divided by the number of valid-design years.

## Reference construction

Start from collected `nis_example()` data and compute `.in_cohort` for every
row. Build year-qualified PSU and stratum identifiers and use original or
annualized `DISCWT` values in `srvyr::as_survey_design(..., nest = TRUE)`.
Apply `dplyr::filter(.in_cohort)` only after constructing that full-data design.
For invalid-row cases, filter out exactly the rows that `nis_design()` excludes
before building the reference. This preserves non-cohort observations in each
hospital-year so domain estimates have the same sampling structure.
